t: r/Persona5 on Reddit: Best place to buy SP items
Is it really cheaper to buy SP off store, than fiddle with plex and Large Skill Injectors? - General Discussion - EVE Online Forums
s: February 1, 2023 - Just curious but I thought the only way to get SP for a character besides time, was to buy Large Skill Injectors off the Eve Market with ISK purchased from selling PLEX. But now I see for 40 dollars I get 1,500,000 SP and a learning accellerator. According to my math, getting a max researched SP character is only around 10k dollars with SP purchased directly from CPP vs 20k dollars if purchasing plex and selling it to buy Large Skill Injectors.

t: Persona 5 Royal: Where To Buy SP Restoration Items
s: November 24, 2024 - For the most part, the only SP restoration items you can reliably buy are Arginade and Water of Rebirth, which are both purchased from Vending Machines. Both of these cost 300 Yen a piece and only two of each can be purchased at a time.
